title: Git setup and SSH authentication
description: Configure Git identity in an isolated repository, inspect remotes and learn safe SSH key handling without uploading keys or mutating global configuration.
objectives: Separate commit author identity from remote authentication
Set local Git identity without modifying global settings
Explain the difference between public and private SSH keys
Create a local repository and verify a commit and safe ignore rules

sources.label: GitHub: Generating a new SSH key

rubric: I configured commit identity in a disposable local repository.
I committed the intended files and verified the secret ignore rules.
I explained public/private keys and host verification and passed the Git fixture tests.
